next_action: Ask user for the DEBUG console output. Then grep sender_screen.dart for all _revertToWaiting() call sites and trace whether any fire AFTER _onReceiverBecameReady() — specifically the else-if at line 246.
context_notes: Architecture: neutral handshake connects users first, then role (send/receive) is assigned. receiverReady signals the receiver opened their mailbox. The full chain: receiver opens mailbox -> receiver selects sender -> selectSenderHandshake() writes receiverReady:true -> sender stream fires -> _onReceiverBecameReady() sets _receiverReady=true -> IgnorePointer gate opens. After this, sender picks file (Step 1), encrypts (Step 2), then Step 3 should be tappable. But _fileEncrypted is somehow false at Step 3 tap time, meaning _encryptedBytes was cleared between Step 2 completion and Step 3 tap.
